other_conditions: Must have completed Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees in science or engineering with at least 60% marks or equivalent grades at both levels.
Candidate should have submitted Ph.D. thesis awaiting degree or already hold a Ph.D. degree.
External applicants must have a Ph.D. and at least two years of research experience.
benefits_summary: Provides a monthly stipend ranging from ₹58,000 to ₹67,000, a one‑time academic allowance of ₹10,000, and accommodation or HRA benefits.
